content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Pharmaceutical companies continue to face intense scrutiny over the soaring costs of prescription drugs, which many argue are unaffordable and unsustainable.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The average price of a single medication has risen dramatically in recent years, putting a strain on both individual patients and healthcare systems.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Patient advocates demand greater transparency and pricing controls, while industry leaders stress the need for continued investment in drug development.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Legislators are considering various measures to curb drug prices, including importation from other countries and government negotiations.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Experts warn that unchecked drug pricing could lead to further health disparities and financial ruin for many families.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: "Drug companies must be held accountable for the exorbitant prices they charge, and we need policies that prioritize the health of our citizens over profits." - Senator John Smith
